Engine and transmission

Engine and transmission repair in Bukit Indah

Rough running, strange noises or a gearbox that shifts hard? We inspect the engine and transmission, explain the cause and quote before we repair.

WhatsApp usCall

What this service covers

The engine and transmission are the heart of your car. They work hard in Johor, where heat and stop-and-go traffic put extra strain on oil, coolant and gearbox fluid. Small faults, like a leak or a worn mount, are cheaper to fix early than after they spread. Engine and transmission work covers diagnosis, repair and replacement of worn parts. We start with a proper inspection and scan so we repair the real cause. Find us at Taman Bukit Indah, near the Second Link, serving Iskandar Puteri and JB.

Signs you need this

  • Engine overheats or the temperature needle climbs in traffic
  • Knocking, ticking or whining noise from the engine bay
  • Gearbox shifts hard, slips or hesitates between gears
  • Oil or fluid drips under the car when parked
  • White, blue or black smoke from the exhaust
  • Engine shakes at idle or lacks power when overtaking

What we do

  1. 01

    Scan and inspect

    We scan the car for fault codes, then inspect the engine, transmission, fluids, mounts and leaks.

  2. 02

    Explain what we found

    We explain the cause in plain words and show you the worn or leaking parts where we can.

  3. 03

    Quote before work

    You get a quote for the repair. We start only after you agree to it.

  4. 04

    Repair

    We repair or replace the faulty parts and refill the oil, coolant or gearbox fluid as needed.

  5. 05

    Test drive

    We scan again, check for leaks and test drive the car to confirm it runs and shifts properly.

  6. 06

    Handover

    We go through what was done and what to watch for in the next few weeks.

Questions drivers ask

Why is my engine overheating?

Common causes are low coolant, a leak, a weak radiator fan, a faulty thermostat or a failing water pump. If the needle goes high, stop safely and switch off. Driving on can cause serious damage. We check the cause first. Let the engine cool before opening the radiator cap.

Why does my car shake when idling?

It can be worn engine mounts, dirty or worn ignition parts, a vacuum leak or a sensor fault. The shake alone does not tell us which. We scan and inspect the car, then explain what we found. Do not ignore a shake that keeps getting worse.

What does a hard gear shift mean?

It can come from old or low gearbox fluid, a sensor fault, or wear inside the gearbox. Do not ignore it. We scan the car and check the fluid first, then tell you the options before any repair.

Is a small oil leak serious?

A small leak can become a bigger one, and low oil can damage the engine. Leaks also reach belts and the road. Check your oil level, top up if low, and let us find the source.

How much does engine or gearbox repair cost?

It depends on the car and what is wrong, so we cannot give a fair figure without inspecting it. WhatsApp 011-6776 1138 with the symptoms and we will tell you how to get a quote. A clear quote helps you decide before work begins.

Should I repair or replace the gearbox?

It depends on the fault and the car. Sometimes a fluid change or a sensor repair is enough. We inspect first, explain the options in plain words and quote each one, so you can decide. Our priority is to fix the cause properly.
